publication_surface.identifier: Official Journal references of harmonised standards supporting Directive 2014/35/EU
publication_surface.authenticity_basis: Directive 2014/35/EU Article 12 makes OJ publication of a harmonised-standard reference the condition for presumption of conformity with covered safety objectives.

dependencies.condition_statement: Presumption of conformity under Directive 2014/35/EU Article 12 depends on conformity with harmonised standards whose references are published in the Official Journal.

scope.statement: Decision (EU) 2025/1464 formally decides not to publish the EN 60335-2-14:2006 reference under Directive 2014/35/EU; it had already not been included in the 2016 LVD harmonised-standard publication, so the high-level Article 12 presumption state remains unavailable but now has a direct formal Commission decision.

forbidden_inferences: The July 2025 non-publication decision newly removed an Article 12 presumption that had remained available under Directive 2014/35/EU immediately before the decision.
The existence or prior citation of EN 60335-2-14:2006 under the predecessor low-voltage directive creates current presumption of conformity under Directive 2014/35/EU.
Formal non-publication means the European standard itself is prohibited or ceases to exist.
Lack of Article 12 presumption means conformity with Directive 2014/35/EU is impossible through another technical route.
notes: Issue #411 frozen product-capability workload case: formal non-publication where the high-level current LVD citation state was already NOT_INCLUDED.
